units.source_text: 世间万事皆空，无常迅速，请勿使我因遭人怨恨而罪孽深重啊！”

en.t: All things in this world are empty, and impermanence comes swiftly; please do not let my sins grow heavier because I have incurred another person's resentment!
He then comforted her with many more words.

units.source_text: 二女公子答道：“我心情非常恶劣……”

en.t: The Second Princess answered, "I feel terribly unwell..."
Then she withdrew into the inner room.

units.source_text: 匂亲王也顾不得旁人讥笑，悲伤愁叹直到天明。

en.t: Prince Niou, heedless of others' ridicule, grieved and sighed until daybreak.

units.source_text: 他想：“她的怨恨确是难怪。

en.t: He thought, "It is only natural that she should resent me.

units.source_text: 然而太不顾人面子，令人伤心落泪。

en.t: Yet she shows such disregard for my dignity that it makes me grieve and brings tears to my eyes.
That shows how deeply sorrowful and indignant she must be."

units.source_text: 他左思右想，觉得二女公子实在可怜。

en.t: He turned the matter over again and again, and felt that the Second Princess was truly pitiable.
